data.name: Tiny Drift
data.detailed_description:
TINY DRIFT is a retro pixel art arena survivor where drifting isn't just how you fight. It's your greatest weapon. Every driver changes the way you play. Every upgrade changes the way you fight. And every victory brings the planet Sirius XII one step closer to freedom. Join the Tiny Drift Squad and show the big bosses who's really in control.

JOIN THE SQUADRON 🚙 🚗 🏎️

Every driver brings their own vehicle, abilities and playstyle.

Rapidfire unleashes energized bullets at the closest enemy. Push the engine into overdrive and turn its rapid fire into an inferno.

Bombshot litters the battlefield with corrosive mines. Lay cunning traps and watch your enemies melt into glowing wrecks.

Zipline electrifies anything that gets too close, unleashing devastating chain reactions. Pull your enemies together and watch the sparks fly.

One final squad member remains classified… You gonna have to find out by your own.

BUILD YOUR DRIFT. 🔥

No two runs feel the same. Five upgrades completely change the way you drive, fight and survive.

One of them is Firedrift: Unlock it and every drift leaves a blazing wall of fire behind you, turning every reckless pursuer into tomorrow's barbecue.

Think Firedrift looks fun? You haven't seen anything yet.

TAKE DOWN GIANTS.

The bigger they are, the harder you have to drift. Battle through four handcrafted stages before facing gigantic bosses determined to crush the Tiny Drift Squad. Master your driving, build powerful loadouts and turn every oversized enemy into scrap.

PLAY THE DEMO NOW

Jump into the first stage of Tiny Drift with three unique drivers, three of the five unlockable upgrades, and your first gigantic boss battle. Experiment with different builds, master the basics and discover how long you can survive. Download the Demo and start drifting.

Can't get enough? The Full Version expands the Squad with a classified fourth driver, unlocks all five upgrades and more, introduces four handcrafted stages, and throws even bigger surprises your way. Wishlist Tiny Drift today and be ready for launch.

You will love Tiny Drift if you played and loved...

Vampire Survivors, Brotato, Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor, Soulstone Survivors, Halls of Torment, Death Must Die, BALL x PIT, Megabonk, The Spell Brigade, Yet Another Zombie Survivors, Grind Survivors, Temtem: Swarm, Nova Drift, Trailmakers, Main Assembly, Instruments of Destruction, Scrap Mechanic, Space Engineers, and From the Depths
